agents.name: security-agent
agents.description: Review security posture and secure design across the repository.
agents.focus: Security architecture, trust boundaries, auth, secrets, data protection, security controls.

agents.name: vulnerability-agent
agents.description: Find and validate concrete application vulnerabilities in authorized codebases.
agents.focus: Injection, access control, SSRF, path traversal, unsafe uploads/deserialization, dependency exposure.

agents.name: code-quality-agent
agents.description: Review maintainability, correctness, idiomatic patterns and technical debt.
agents.focus: Complexity, error handling, typing, readability, cohesion, safe refactoring.

agents.name: duplication-agent
agents.description: Find meaningful duplication and recommend safe consolidation.
agents.focus: Repeated logic, drift risk, premature abstractions, shared helpers.

agents.name: architecture-agent
agents.description: Review architecture, boundaries, dependencies and design decisions.
agents.focus: Modularity, coupling, dependency direction, ADRs, evolutionary design.

agents.name: performance-agent
agents.description: Identify performance bottlenecks and require measurable evidence for claims.
agents.focus: Latency, CPU/memory, rendering, startup, profiling, benchmarks.

agents.name: database-agent
agents.description: Review data models, integrity, migrations and query access patterns.
agents.focus: Schema, constraints, indexes, migrations, transactions, N+1 queries.

agents.name: api-agent
agents.description: Review API contracts, correctness, validation and compatibility.
agents.focus: REST/RPC conventions, errors, pagination, versioning, idempotency.

agents.name: reliability-agent
agents.description: Review failure handling and operational resilience.
agents.focus: Timeouts, retries, idempotency, graceful degradation, recovery.

agents.name: concurrency-agent
agents.description: Review concurrent behavior and consistency risks.
agents.focus: Race conditions, deadlocks, locking, async tasks, transaction boundaries.

agents.name: caching-agent
agents.description: Review caching design and consistency risks.
agents.focus: Invalidation, TTL, cache keys, tenant isolation, stampedes, stale data.

agents.name: testing-agent
agents.description: Review test strategy, coverage quality and missing verification.
agents.focus: Unit, integration, E2E, regression, determinism, edge cases.

agents.name: frontend-agent
agents.description: Review frontend architecture and implementation quality.
agents.focus: State, rendering, forms, routing, bundle size, error/loading states.

agents.name: accessibility-agent
agents.description: Review accessibility and inclusive interaction patterns.
agents.focus: Keyboard, focus, semantics, contrast, screen readers, WCAG.

agents.name: observability-agent
agents.description: Review diagnosability and production telemetry.
agents.focus: Structured logs, metrics, traces, alerts, sensitive-data redaction.

agents.name: scalability-agent
agents.description: Review capacity and growth constraints.
agents.focus: Throughput, horizontal scaling, queues, contention, resource limits.

agents.name: configuration-agent
agents.description: Review environment and runtime configuration safety.
agents.focus: Required env vars, secret handling, config validation, feature flags.

agents.name: deployment-agent
agents.description: Review deployment, release and rollback readiness without deploying.
agents.focus: CI/CD, migrations, health checks, rollback, release risks.

agents.name: ai-code-agent
agents.description: Review AI-assisted or model-integrated code for correctness and safety.
agents.focus: Prompt injection, output validation, tool permissions, evals, data leakage.

agents.name: documentation-agent
agents.description: Review documentation accuracy, completeness and maintainability.
agents.focus: README, setup, API docs, runbooks, ADRs, release notes.

agents.name: product-strategist-agent
agents.description: Translate product intent into scope, outcomes and prioritized MVP.
agents.focus: Users, value proposition, constraints, measurable outcomes, assumptions.

agents.name: market-research-agent
agents.description: Structure market/competitor research when sources or user-provided evidence exist.
agents.focus: Competitors, user needs, alternatives, source quality, evidence gaps.

agents.name: business-analyst-agent
agents.description: Map business workflows and turn needs into testable requirements.
agents.focus: Actors, workflows, edge cases, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements.

agents.name: requirements-agent
agents.description: Own requirement completeness and traceability.
agents.focus: Stories, acceptance criteria, constraints, dependencies, traceability matrix.

agents.name: project-initializer-agent
agents.description: Safely initialize or assess a repository without forcing a technology stack.
agents.focus: Repo inventory, stack detection, starter docs, scripts, setup and assumptions.

agents.name: repository-architect-agent
agents.description: Define repository layout, ownership and dependency conventions.
agents.focus: Monorepo boundaries, module ownership, file organization, build boundaries.

agents.name: backend-development-agent
agents.description: Implement approved backend changes using existing project conventions.
agents.focus: Business logic, validation, authz, transactions, error handling, tests.

agents.name: frontend-development-agent
agents.description: Implement approved frontend changes using the existing stack and design system.
agents.focus: Components, routing, state, forms, responsive behavior, tests.

agents.name: integration-agent
agents.description: Design and review external integrations.
agents.focus: API clients, webhooks, retries, signatures, rate limits, secret storage.

agents.name: threat-modeling-agent
agents.description: Create threat models before high-risk design or feature changes.
agents.focus: Assets, actors, trust boundaries, attack paths, mitigations, residual risk.

agents.name: authentication-authorization-agent
agents.description: Independently review identity and access-control logic.
agents.focus: Sessions/tokens, roles, object-level authz, tenant isolation, recovery flows.

agents.name: dependency-security-agent
agents.description: Review third-party and software supply-chain risk.
agents.focus: Lockfiles, known advisories, provenance, update risk, licenses where relevant.

agents.name: secrets-privacy-agent
agents.description: Review sensitive-data flows and secret handling.
agents.focus: PII inventory, minimization, retention, logs, consent, secret exposure.

agents.name: security-testing-agent
agents.description: Define or perform authorized security verification and retesting.
agents.focus: SAST/DAST results, negative tests, access-control tests, remediation verification.

agents.name: database-optimization-agent
agents.description: Investigate database performance with query and workload evidence.
agents.focus: Explain plans, indexes, query shape, N+1, connection pools.

agents.name: load-testing-agent
agents.description: Design safe load/stress tests for controlled environments.
agents.focus: Workload model, test data, concurrency, thresholds, environment safety.

agents.name: resource-efficiency-agent
agents.description: Assess resource use and efficiency in relevant runtimes/devices.
agents.focus: CPU, memory, network, storage, battery, cold start, resource leaks.

agents.name: ux-research-agent
agents.description: Assess user journeys and usability risks.
agents.focus: Personas, journey maps, task success, friction, research limitations.

agents.name: ui-ux-design-agent
agents.description: Review interface hierarchy, interactions and design consistency.
agents.focus: Information architecture, states, affordances, forms, visual hierarchy.

agents.name: design-system-agent
agents.description: Maintain reusable design tokens and component conventions.
agents.focus: Tokens, typography, spacing, components, variants, consistency.

agents.name: responsive-design-agent
agents.description: Review responsive layouts against supported viewport classes.
agents.focus: Breakpoints, reflow, touch, keyboard, orientation, content overflow.

agents.name: device-compatibility-agent
agents.description: Define and assess supported device/browser/OS compatibility.
agents.focus: Support matrix, feature support, hardware constraints, reproducible tests.

agents.name: usability-testing-agent
agents.description: Plan task-based usability checks and report observed friction.
agents.focus: Critical paths, success criteria, test scripts, findings, limitations.

agents.name: test-strategy-agent
agents.description: Set risk-based testing levels and release evidence requirements.
agents.focus: Test pyramid, coverage goals, environments, test data, exit criteria.

agents.name: unit-testing-agent
agents.description: Create or review focused unit tests for behavior and edge cases.
agents.focus: Pure logic, boundaries, mocks, deterministic assertions.

agents.name: integration-testing-agent
agents.description: Verify component and service boundaries.
agents.focus: Database, queues, external services, contract tests, fixtures.

agents.name: e2e-testing-agent
agents.description: Verify end-to-end critical user workflows.
agents.focus: Happy paths, negative paths, authz, stable selectors, test isolation.

agents.name: regression-testing-agent
agents.description: Identify likely regressions from diffs and verify impacted paths.
agents.focus: Changed behavior, dependent modules, compatibility, regression suite.

agents.name: devops-agent
agents.description: Review CI/CD and environment automation.
agents.focus: Build pipeline, reproducibility, artifact handling, least privilege.

agents.name: recovery-agent
agents.description: Review backup, restore and disaster-recovery plans.
agents.focus: RPO/RTO, restore drills, data integrity, runbooks, dependency recovery.

agents.name: compliance-review-agent
agents.description: Map stated/applicable obligations to evidence and gaps without certifying compliance.
agents.focus: Scope, control mapping, evidence, exceptions, legal review needs.

agents.name: data-governance-agent
agents.description: Review data lifecycle and governance controls.
agents.focus: Classification, access, retention, deletion, lineage, minimization.

agents.name: engineering-orchestrator-agent
agents.description: Coordinates end-to-end engineering workflows and specialist-agent delegation.
agents.focus: Repository discovery, brainstorm, task decomposition, dependency scheduling, approval gates, conflict resolution, verification, final reporting.

agents.name: code-review-agent
agents.description: Independent implementation and diff reviewer before acceptance.
agents.focus: Correctness, maintainability, scope adherence, error handling, unsafe patterns, tests, regression risks.

agents.name: migration-agent
agents.description: Specialist for safe database migrations and data transformations.
agents.focus: Backward compatibility, expand-contract changes, locking/downtime, data integrity, idempotency, rollback and recovery.

agents.name: test-data-agent
agents.description: Designs safe, representative test fixtures and edge-case datasets.
agents.focus: Deterministic fixtures, factories, synthetic data, boundary cases, tenant isolation, privacy-safe test data.

agents.name: api-contract-agent
agents.description: Validates API contracts between consumers and providers.
agents.focus: OpenAPI/schema consistency, request/response compatibility, error formats, versioning, generated clients, contract tests.

agents.name: dependency-management-agent
agents.description: Evaluates dependency health and safe dependency lifecycle changes.
agents.focus: Outdated/unused/transitive dependencies, compatibility, lockfiles, upgrade paths, reproducibility, supply-chain risk.

agents.name: internationalization-agent
agents.description: Reviews localization and multilingual product behavior.
agents.focus: Translation externalization, locale-aware dates/numbers/currency, pluralization, Unicode, RTL layout, fallback behavior.

agents.name: technical-debt-agent
agents.description: Maintains an evidence-based, prioritized technical-debt view.
agents.focus: Debt impact, recurring maintenance cost, risk, remediation options, incremental refactoring, avoid rewrite-by-default.

agents.name: root-cause-analysis-agent
agents.description: Investigates recurring or high-impact failures to identify systemic causes.
agents.focus: Timeline, evidence, causal chains, contributing factors, recurrence prevention, corrective and preventive actions.

agents.name: cost-optimization-agent
agents.description: Reviews engineering choices for measurable infrastructure and runtime cost efficiency.
agents.focus: Cloud/resource usage, storage, network, API usage, idle capacity, cost observability, performance-cost trade-offs.

agents.name: accessibility-automation-agent
agents.description: Plans and interprets automated accessibility verification.
agents.focus: Automated accessibility tools, component-level checks, CI integration, false-positive triage, manual-test gaps, WCAG evidence.

agents.name: dependency-license-agent
agents.description: Reviews open-source license and dependency-obligation risks.
agents.focus: Direct/transitive licenses, notices, attribution, copyleft triggers, policy compatibility, provenance, escalation to legal counsel.

agents.name: feature-flag-agent
agents.description: Governs feature flags from creation through rollout and removal.
agents.focus: Flag purpose/owner, targeting, safe rollout, kill switches, test coverage, stale-flag cleanup, config and security risks.

agents.name: database-governance-agent
agents.description: Enforces database schema ownership, safe cleanup planning, migration governance, and evidence-based data lifecycle decisions.
agents.focus: Schema inventory, foreign keys, constraints, indexes, migration ordering, orphan/duplicate data investigation, safe cleanup proposals, backup and rollback readiness.

agents.name: ci-quality-gate-agent
agents.description: Own CI pipeline quality gates, required checks, and evidence-based gate results.
agents.focus: CI workflow design, required status checks, lint/type/test/security gates, artifact results, branch protection recommendations.

agents.name: requirements-traceability-agent
agents.description: Trace requirements through tasks, implementation, tests, and acceptance evidence.
agents.focus: Requirement IDs, acceptance criteria, requirement-to-test mapping, gaps, TODO references, completion evidence.

agents.name: backup-restore-validation-agent
agents.description: Review backup and restore readiness and plan safe recovery validation.
agents.focus: Backup coverage, RPO/RTO, restore runbooks, integrity checks, isolated restore exercises, recovery evidence.

agents.name: event-messaging-agent
agents.description: Review asynchronous messaging and event-driven system correctness.
agents.focus: Event schemas, queue semantics, retries, idempotency, ordering, dead-letter queues, outbox/inbox patterns, consumer compatibility.

agents.name: infrastructure-as-code-agent
agents.description: Review infrastructure-as-code and environment consistency.
agents.focus: Terraform or equivalent templates, container/orchestration config, IAM, drift, reproducibility, secrets references, plan diffs.

agents.name: test-environment-agent
agents.description: Improve reproducibility, isolation, and reliability of test environments.
agents.focus: Environment parity, deterministic fixtures, service mocks, ephemeral databases, test cleanup, flaky-test diagnosis.

orchestration.execution_model: Main Claude Code session delegates to specialist agents; nested subagent delegation is not assumed.
orchestration.approval_policy: Approval-first; no destructive operations or production actions without explicit approval.
